subject: Recap + next steps: ClearPath discovery (integration, security, economics)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Cooper <liam.cooper@clearpathretail.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@clearpathretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps: ClearPath discovery (integration, security, economics)

Hi Liam / Sofia — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick written recap so we have a single plan to share with your team and our legal/procurement folks. I attached a first-pass MAP (ClearPath_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short security evidence summary.

Top takeaways from the call:
- Use case: real-time in-store personalization (inventory-aware prompts) + enterprise search across product catalog and POS data.
- Integration: ClearPath will want a hybrid integration pattern — on-prem POS connector that routes anonymized signals to Redwood hosted inference for model scoring.
- Non-negotiables: SOC 2 Type II evidence, an approved DPA, and a procurement-approved IP/data handling clause.
- Success criteria: 50ms median tail latency for scoring at 256 token contexts, < $0.003 per inference unit at scale, accuracy metrics TBD (sample prompts to follow).

Proposed next steps (please confirm owners and dates):
1) Economic buyer & exec sponsor: please confirm who owns budget/contract sign-off at ClearPath. (Action: ClearPath) — target: this week
2) Security & compliance checklist: ClearPath to share required compliance artifacts/contacts; Redwood to map evidence. (Action: ClearPath + Redwood) — target: 4/22
3) Procurement / legal intake: share DPA redline window and procurement timeline; Redwood to send DPA guidance. (Action: ClearPath + Redwood) — target: 4/30
4) MAP draft review: we attached ClearPath_MAP_v1.xlsx. We'll update responsibilities/dates after you confirm names. (Action: Evelyn) — target: 4/20
5) Technical kickoff (SOW/PoC scoping): 60-minute session with Eng + SRE to align on connector architecture and data flow. (Action: Ben/Redwood & ClearPath eng) — target: week of 5/3

Questions for you now: who is the economic buyer (name/email)? who is procurement (name/email)? any specific security evidence beyond SOC2 (PCI, ISO27001, internal pen test reports)?

If the next steps look right I'll update the MAP with confirmed owners and push a HubSpot update (deal CP-4521). Proposed follow-up call: Tue 4/20 10am PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearPath_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), security_evidence_summary.pdf (2pg),

---
From: Liam Cooper <liam.cooper@clearpathretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@clearpathretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: ClearPath discovery (integration, security, economics)

Thanks Evelyn — appreciate the concise recap. Quick answers below.

- Economic buyer / exec sponsor: Sofia Martinez (VP Merchandising) will be the exec sponsor and budget approver. I am the technical lead and will coordinate engineering and procurement.
- Procurement contact: Emily Thomas (emily.thomas@clearpathretail.com) handles vendor intake and contracts. She asked for an initial DPA and SOC2 evidence.
- Security asks: PCI is not required for this pilot; SOC 2 Type II + a recent internal pen-test summary will be ideal. If Redwood has an ISO27001 cert that helps but not mandatory.
- Timeline: Sofia would like procurement terms and the MAP in the next 7–10 business days; aiming to start a paid PoC in mid-May.

Re: the MAP — I'll take a first pass on owners (I'll propose Emily for procurement, Sofia as exec owner, Liam for integration), then push back any changes. Tue 4/20 10am PT works for our team.
